Description: Chat with AI assistant for pet care advice booking support and clinic operations
Pre-conditions:
- User is authenticated (PET_OWNER STAFF CLINIC_MANAGER or CLINIC_OWNER)
- Valid JWT token is present
- WebSocket connection is established
- AI service is reachable and enabled
- Active chat session exists or can be created

Description: Admin configures AI model parameters (model type temperature max tokens) to control agent behavior
Pre-conditions:
- User is authenticated with ADMIN role
- AI agent is enabled and active
- Admin AI configuration page is accessible
- Database connection is available for saving changes
- OpenRouter API is configured with available models

Description: Admin tests AI agent in isolated environment to verify behavior and tune parameters
Pre-conditions:
- User is authenticated with ADMIN role
- AI agent is enabled and active
- Playground session is isolated from business chat
- AI service is reachable and responsive
- Trace visibility is enabled for inspection

Description: Admin enables/disables individual AI tools (Knowledge Search Booking Clinic Search) as needed
Pre-conditions:
- User is authenticated with ADMIN role
- Tool registry is loaded from database
- At least one tool remains active
- System can persist tool state changes immediately
- AI agent can receive updated configuration

Description: Admin uploads documents (PDF DOCX TXT) to knowledge base for AI RAG retrieval
Pre-conditions:
- User is authenticated with ADMIN role
- Document file format is valid (PDF DOCX TXT or MD)
- Document size is under 10 MB
- Document storage service is available
- Qdrant Cloud vector database is connected

Description: Admin removes outdated or incorrect documents from knowledge base to prevent AI retrieval errors
Pre-conditions:
- User is authenticated with ADMIN role
- Document exists and is fully indexed
- Document is not currently being indexed
- Vector database connection is available for cleanup
- Confirmation modal can be displayed before deletion

Description: Admin views confirmed medical cases to monitor AI learning quality
Pre-conditions:
- User is authenticated with ADMIN role
- Confirmed medical cases exist in Qdrant
- AI Insights page is accessible
- Case memory storage is reachable
- Pagination is available if case count exceeds limit

Description: Admin removes incorrect or low-quality cases from memory to prevent AI from learning noisy data
Pre-conditions:
- User is authenticated with ADMIN role
- Case exists and is identifiable in memory pool
- Case is not referenced by active diagnosis session
- Extra confirmation is available for high-quality cases (score > 0.9)
- Audit logging system is operational

Function Name: Use AI-Assisted Clinic Setup and Operation
Description: CLINIC_OWNER or CLINIC_MANAGER uses AI to assist with clinic service setup and daily operations
Pre-conditions:
- User is authenticated as CLINIC_OWNER or CLINIC_MANAGER
- User is assigned to an active clinic
- Clinic data is loaded (bookings staff services)
- Mascot panel is functional on dashboard
- AI tools for clinic operations are enabled

Function Name: Use Summarize patient info and EMR
Description: STAFF requests AI summary of patient medical history to support consultation and handover
Pre-conditions:
- User is authenticated with STAFF role
- User is authorized to view patient clinic records
- Patient belongs to staff clinic or current booking
- Patient EMR or vaccination records are accessible
- AI summary generation service is operational

Description: PET_OWNER views friendly health overview of their pet with reminders and visit highlights
Pre-conditions:
- User is authenticated with PET_OWNER role
- User is the registered owner of the pet
- Pet profile exists and is accessible
- Pet has at least one EMR or vaccination record
- AI Health Card component is rendered on Pet Details screen

Description: Admin reviews AI feedback statistics to track performance and identify improvement areas
Pre-conditions:
- User is authenticated with ADMIN role
- User feedback data exists in database
- AI Insights analytics page is accessible
- Aggregation query service is operational
- Chart rendering components are functional

Description: Users rate AI responses (positive/negative) to help the system improve answer quality
Pre-conditions:
- User is authenticated (any registered role)
- AI response message is visible in chat thread
- User has not rated this message before
- Feedback submission service is operational
- Reason selection UI is available for negative ratings

Description: STAFF uses AI for differential diagnosis suggestions and SOAP drafting during EMR entry
Pre-conditions:
- User is authenticated with STAFF role
- EMR editor is open with active patient visit
- Staff has permission to edit the EMR record
- Clinical findings (symptoms observations) are entered
- Case Memory and Knowledge Base are available for retrieval
